hyp_1.note: mechanism: loss of RBM20 mis-splices TTN, compromising the sarcomere and leading to DCM; TTN is the hypothesis's second gene, its claim the same chain from TTN

hyp_2.note: mechanism: disrupting the TNNT2-MYH7 interaction lowers contractility and leads to DCM; MYH7 is the hypothesis's second gene

hyp_3.note: mechanism: LMNA mutations disrupt the nuclear lamina and lead to DCM; the title names no variant

findings.detail: all three hypotheses have empty supporting_evidence and contradicting_evidence; the run cites only chain steps, so there are no contradicting citations to judge

every process-to-DCM step cites only gene-level records (Open Targets scores, MGI genotype-shows-DCM rows, and at hyp_3.3 the LMNA UniProt entry, which never mentions DCM) that never name the process, so the three disease steps keep no evidence

the run fetched gene-to-DCM evidence (OT genetic_association 0.91-0.97; Ttn, Rbm20, Tnnt2 mice with DCM) but its chain template routes the disease link through a generic process, where that evidence cannot attach; the arms compose without it and bridges are only for arms that need one, so it lands nowhere

nothing cited says TNNT2 activates MYH7: UniProt says troponin T confers calcium sensitivity to actomyosin ATPase (regulation, no direction, no MYH7), the MYH7 entry never mentions troponin, and the STRING edge is text-mining
the run's own note says TNNT2 'confers calcium-sensitivity' to the ATPase; the run turned a calcium-dependent regulation into 'activates' (+)

UniProt P02545 says LMNA is 'Required for cardiac homeostasis' directly; the run inserted nuclear envelope organization between them, and nothing cited links nuclear envelope organization to cardiac homeostasis

AGR:MGI:2155600 is a Tg(Myh6-Myh7) transgenic with decreased contractility; read as added Myh7 it would refute 'MYH7 required for contractility', yet the run cites it in support (excluded as no_direction since the record does not say)
STRING records cited for directed steps: two text-mined edges (experiments 0.11) and one GO over-representation result; none can carry a direction

the run left CURIEs empty (kind 'other') for sarcomere organization, cardiac muscle contractility, nuclear envelope organization, cardiac homeostasis and cardiac muscle cell, though exact GO and CL terms exist for four of them (GO:0045214, GO:0006998, CL:0000746; GO:0060048 for contraction)

MONDO:0005021 defines DCM as 'characterized by dilation and contractile dysfunction', so 'contractility inhibits DCM' restates a defining feature; kept as the run's causal step, with no bridge from the definition
all three hypotheses are 'low' confidence and 'speculative'; that matches the curation, where only UniProt function text survives and no disease step keeps evidence

the mechanisms name specific events (TTN mis-splicing and extensibility; nuclear rupture under contraction stress) but the chains reduce them to generic processes (sarcomere organization, nuclear envelope organization, cardiac homeostasis), so the specific mechanism is never stated as a step

the mechanism turns on an 'interaction between TNNT2 and MYH7', but the only record pairing them is a text-mined STRING edge (experiments 0.11); the run's own P45379 makes troponin T the tropomyosin-binding subunit of the thin-filament regulatory complex, and P12883 puts MYH7 in the thick filament, which describes an indirect, calcium-gated relation, not an interaction
the falsification reads out contractile force (a node of hyp_2's chain), not sarcomere organization, so a result would not test hyp_1.2 or hyp_1.3 as written
the falsification reads out nuclear rupture and apoptosis under stretch, neither of which is a step; nuclear envelope organization and cardiac homeostasis are never measured
every falsification has expected 'unknown' and null perturbation, readout and system; only the free-text description is filled

the run abstains on ABCB9 and OR8J3 (insufficient evidence), a reasonable call, but its six evidence accessions (HPA, Q9NP78, CXG, GWAS no-association) are not in sources.json, so the abstention cannot be checked

no target for splicing or isoform switching: 'RBM20 essential for TTN isoform transition' was expressed as RBM20 raising TTN activity, which loses that RBM20 represses exon inclusion and shifts isoforms rather than raising function

no form for a conditional regulator ('confers calcium-sensitivity to actomyosin ATPase'): troponin both inhibits and permits the ATPase depending on calcium, which neither a pos nor a neg effect captures

the run gives a cell-type context (cardiac muscle cell) on two steps; a refinement would cut the chain because the neighbouring steps use the base node and no rule lets a general statement feed its refined node, so the context was dropped

the fetched MGI rows name the genotype symbol but not whether the allele is a knockout, a missense or a transgenic over-expression, so a model-organism phenotype can never sign a gene step even when the phenotype is directional ('decreased cardiac muscle contractility')
curated.json has no place for the run's abstention, a claim that ABCB9 and OR8J3 have no link to DCM; it is recorded only as a finding

'cardiac homeostasis' has no term; grounded as GO:0060249 anatomical structure homeostasis refined to UBERON:0000948 heart (the heart is an organ, so not GO:0001894 tissue homeostasis, which is 'within a defined tissue') rather than a BLN term or ungroundable, since UniProt uses the same phrase
'cardiac muscle contractility' (a capacity) grounded as GO:0060048 cardiac muscle contraction (a process); PATO:0001579 contractility has no cardiac form in the label table

two UniProt spans were kept on near-synonyms: titin as 'key component in the assembly ... of striated muscles' for sarcomere organization, and generic 'Myosins ... essential for muscle contraction' in the MYH7 entry for cardiac muscle contraction

audit.before: refines GO:0001894 tissue homeostasis, ctx anatomy UBERON:0000948 heart
audit.after: refines GO:0060249 anatomical structure homeostasis, ctx anatomy UBERON:0000948 heart
audit.reason: GO:0001894 is homeostasis 'within a defined tissue'; the heart is an organ, so tissue homeostasis refined to heart names a narrower node than the run's 'cardiac homeostasis'. GO:0060249 (its parent) covers any anatomical structure, including an organ

no_direction is for record types that cannot carry a sign (an MGI 'abnormal X' row); this row names both ends (Myh7, cardiac muscle contractility) and its phenotype is directional ('decreased'), what is missing is the direction of the genotype's change to Myh7: the guide's 'names both ends but gives no direction'

the text does state the step's relation and object ('Required for cardiac homeostasis'), but for LMNA, not for nuclear envelope organization; the curator's own reason describes a subject swap, which is not_this_entity
